stem:
The clinical practice guideline management of blood borne viruses (BBV), hepatitis B (HBV), recommended within the hemodialysis unit from Taiwan Society of Nephrology.

Which one of the following descriptions is NOT CORRECT?

options.text: HBsAg positive patients be dialyzed in isolation or cohorted in an area that is separate to that where patients who are HBsAg negative receive dialysis
Healthcare staff with well hand hygiene and personal protective equipment can allow taking care of hepatitis B patients and patients who are not immune to hepatitis B virus at the same time.
Designated Hemodialysis machines for hepatitis B patients must be thoroughly disinfected between shifts.
Healthcare staffs should wear at least mask and eye protection during cannulation and de-cannulation procedures for caring hepatitis B patients within the hemodialysis session.

stem: A 29 y/o man with a history of hypertension worked out at a hot environment. He felt nauseous after a 30-minute smelling something like ammonia. The associated symptoms including dizziness and mild dyspnea. Because of above symptoms, he went to our ER immediately and laboratory data disclosed elevated methemoglobin of 15%. CXR revealed no active lung lesion. Which of the following is the most likely causative agent for his condition?
